prior_freeze.selection_rationale: neither protocol cleanly dominated on strong-instruct ASCII controls; few-shot retained because it is the prespecified carrier for weak/vintage models and consistency across models dominates per-model optimization
prior_freeze.selection_rule: Use one copy protocol for every model. Select fewshot_copy_v1 when it passes strong-instruct ASCII controls within 2/24 of instruction-only; select instruction_v1 only if few-shot drops strong-instruct performance by more than 2/24 and below the 23/24 gate while instruction passes; otherwise prefer few-shot for weak/vintage carrier consistency.
